source: NeoKid Care Phase 3 — safety envelopes around the app's DRUGS formulary (standard paediatric references; IAP/Nelson's-style ranges). ref = wide mg/kg envelope the formulary dose must sit inside (self-consistency gate, tested). Hard-stop rules: implausible weight, anaphylaxis allergy match, NSAID in dengue (WHO/CDC contraindicate NSAIDs in dengue — bleeding risk).

contraRules.text: NSAID contraindicated in dengue — bleeding risk (WHO/CDC). Use paracetamol.
Ask about NSAID-triggered wheeze before giving an NSAID.
Cotrimoxazole in G6PD deficiency — haemolysis risk; confirm choice.
Cotrimoxazole under 2 months — use only if benefit outweighs risk.

interactions.text: QT caution: ondansetron + azithromycin together — ECG/caution if cardiac history.
QT caution: domperidone + azithromycin together — caution if cardiac history.
